formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj], (∀ a b c : Fin n, G.Adj a b → G.Adj b c → ¬ G.Adj c a) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, G.Adj a b → G.Adj b c → G.Adj c d → G.Adj d a → a = c ∨ b = d) → ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, (∀ g ∈ C.gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j ∧ x i = true ∧ x j = true)) ∧ (∀ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, (∀ g ∈ D.gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, D.eval (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j ∧ x i = true ∧ x j = true)) → C.size ≤ D.size) ∧ ∀ (t : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[t]? = some g → g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ c : Fin n, (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ ((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin n => decide (k = u ∨ k = v)))).getD (n + t) false = true ∧ ∀ (t' : ℕ) (g' : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[t']? = some g' → g'.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → Relation.TransGen (fun a b : ℕ => a < b ∧ ∃ (k : ℕ) (h : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), b = n + k ∧ C.gates[k]? = some h ∧ a ∈ h.inputs) (n + t') (n + t) → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin n => decide (k = u ∨ k = v)))).getD (n + t') false = false)) ∧ ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → ((C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin n => decide (k = u ∨ k = v)))).getD (n + t) false = true ∧ ∀ (t' : ℕ) (g' : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[t']? = some g' → g'.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → Relation.TransGen (fun a b : ℕ => a < b ∧ ∃ (k : ℕ) (h : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), b = n + k ∧ C.gates[k]? = some h ∧ a ∈ h.inputs) (n + t') (n + t) → (C.wires (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin n => decide (k = u ∨ k = v)))).getD (n + t') false = false) → u = c ∨ v = c
plain_statement: Let G be a graph with no triangle and no 4-cycle, and F_G the function that is true when both ends of some edge are true. Among circuits of AND and OR gates with at most two inputs each computing F_G, some circuit of least size has this property: every AND gate g owns at least one edge, and all the edges it owns share one vertex. Here g owns the edge uv when g is true on the input whose only true coordinates are u and v, and no AND gate in the cone of g (a gate g reads, directly or through other gates) is true on that input.
title: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate owning a star of edges
